# Welcome to `asset-lint` contributing guide
Thank you for investing your time to make `asset-lint` a better tool.

This guide provides specific guidelines for a successful cooperation between contributors.

## Contribution types
Any kind of contribution is welcome. Here is a brief list to give some idea:
- Improve the wiki
- Report bugs
- Request features
- Improve the code

You can read more of each below.

## Improve the wiki
Currently the wiki is only editable by maintainers.
If you find a place that should be edited, create a bug report including
what is the current text, and what you think it should say.

A maintainer will pick that issue up and create a commit crediting you as a co-author.

Please keep the abbreviations minimal, and make sure that the text is understandable
for a junior game developer.

## Report bugs
We try our best to make `asset-lint` as reliable as possible, but bugs are unavoidable in software.
Sorry for any inconvenience that `asset-lint` caused to you.

Make sure your `asset-lint` is up to date, and check the existing issues.
Maybe someone has reported your problem already. Give them a like (or any reaction).
Bugs with the highest reaction count will be prioritized.

If there's no reported issue yet, head to the issues page, select the report a bug option,
and fill the relevant fields.

Please don't use the bug report to mention a missing functionality. Use the Feature request in this case.

## Request a feature
Have a great idea how can `asset-lint` help you streamline your workflow? Awesome!

Check out the existing issues, maybe there's one request that covers your use case.
React on that issue instead creating a new one.
High reaction count will signal to the maintainers that feature is highly valuable for multiple people.

In case there's no similar request yet, click on the new issue button,
select the request a feature option, and fill the relevant fields.

Keep in mind, that only you know your workflow. *Would you kindly*
give a short description how you use currently `asset-lint` and what
part of the workflow would be more streamlined.

## Improve the code
You know Rust and want to help, great!  
Pick an issue that you'd like to work on, and create a PR for that.
Please, keep your changes relevant to the issue and add tests that validate your work.
Try not to change the `asset-lint-list` format, if necessary only add fields, and never remove or rename.
LLMs may be used as development tools, but contributors are responsible for understanding and testing their changes. Fully AI generated PRs, including code and descriptions might be rejected.

---
Thanks for contributing to `asset-lint`!
